guide.addDescription: Follow your provider's setup instructions, then connect it to your organization.
guide.afterSave: After saving, verify your email domain with the DNS TXT record in Z8. Pilot sign-in with an intended user while keeping your current administrator session open. In Guided setup, save the same provider ID and email domain shown in the provider list, then manually record the observed sign-in result before considering Require SSO. Saving and DNS verification do not prove a successful sign-in.
guide.connectionHelp: Copy these values from your provider's application settings.
guide.copyFailed: Clipboard access failed. Select and copy the text manually.

entra.clientHelp: Copy Application (client) ID from Overview, not Object ID.
entra.consentError: Consent or access denied: Ask your Entra administrator to check consent policies and whether the pilot user is assigned to the application.
entra.description: Connect your organization's Microsoft directory with a single-tenant OpenID Connect application.
entra.generatedIssuer: Issuer URL · generated from your tenant ID

ids.body: On the app's Overview, copy Directory (tenant) ID and Application (client) ID into Z8. The Object ID is a different value. Z8 builds the tenant-specific issuer URL for you.
ids.title: Copy the tenant and application IDs

entra.introduction: Create a Web app registration, copy your tenant and application IDs, and add a client secret. Z8 generates the issuer URL and guides you through each step.
entra.permissions: Z8 uses openid, email, and profile for sign-in. Some connections also request offline_access for refresh tokens. You do not need directory-wide Microsoft Graph permissions. Your tenant's consent policy may still require administrator approval.

redirect.body: In Authentication, add a redirect URI for the Web platform. Paste the Z8 callback shown here exactly. Use Web, not Single-page application. You do not need to enable implicit grant.
redirect.title: Add the Web redirect URI

entra.redirectError: AADSTS50011: Check that the Web redirect URI matches the callback shown by Z8 exactly, including its hostname and path.

register.body: Open Entra ID → App registrations → New registration. Name the app Z8 and choose Accounts in this organizational directory only. Select your organization's directory first. If you cannot register apps, ask your Entra administrator to create one for you.
register.title: Register an application

secret.body: Go to Certificates & secrets → Client secrets → New client secret. Paste its Value into Z8, not its Secret ID. The Value is shown only once. Record the expiry and replace the credential before it expires. Share the Value only through your organization's secure channel.
secret.title: Create a client secret

entra.secretError: Invalid client secret: Use the secret's Value, not its ID. Check that it belongs to this application and has not expired. Create a new secret if you no longer have the Value.
entra.secretHelp: Certificates & secrets → Client secrets. Paste the Value, not the Secret ID. Z8 will not display it again.
entra.tenantError: Wrong tenant: Copy Directory (tenant) ID from the same app registration as the client ID. This guided setup uses a specific tenant, not common or organizations.
entra.tenantHelp: App registrations → your app → Overview. Use your tenant ID, not common or organizations.
entra.tenantInvalid: Enter the Directory (tenant) ID as a complete UUID.
entra.title: Set up Microsoft Entra ID

credentials.body: Enter a unique provider ID, the OIDC issuer URL, your organization's email domain, the client ID, and the client secret. Find these in your provider's application settings. Transfer secrets through a secure channel.
credentials.title: Copy the application settings

generic.description: Use your provider's documentation to create a confidential Web application with the authorization code flow.

redirect.body: Add the Z8 callback shown here to the application's allowed redirect URIs. Copy it exactly, including the organization hostname and path.
redirect.title: Register the callback URL

register.body: In your identity provider, create an OpenID Connect application using the authorization code flow. Assign a small pilot group first.
register.title: Create a Web application

generic.title: Set up an OIDC provider

guide.getStartedDescription: Follow a provider-specific walkthrough without piecing together the configuration yourself.

handoff.description: Copy the setup instructions and your organization's callback URL. The checklist never includes credentials.
handoff.return: Return the tenant ID (for Entra) and application client ID to the Z8 administrator. Transfer the client secret Value separately through a secure channel; do not paste it into this checklist.
handoff.title: Need help from your IT administrator?

guide.manualAvailable: Using another provider? Choose manual OIDC configuration in the setup panel.
guide.scopes: Sign-in scopes include openid, email, and profile. Some connections also request offline_access for refresh tokens.
